body:
Can a bounded official Repo2RLEnv run feed portable task exports directly into the manifest validator, without per-repository Python edits or additional LLM repairs? Subissue of #33; validation component: [PR #46](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/46).

**Current status:** the generic local export-to-validator handoff is implemented and checked: 11 offline checks pass, and all 12 historical Cobrapy raw exports pass through the unchanged official exporter into real validator plans. All 120 file modes and grading assets/settings are preserved; completed re-invocation is inert. [Proof](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/092f9054/experiments/45-generation-handoff/historical-handoff-proof.json), [verified HF receipt and cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7b72b810/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-handoff-hf-receipt.json). These are historical local preparation/planning results: no fresh generation or native controls.

**Next:** implement and checkpoint the trusted generation controller, paid-call admission and remote interruption/cleanup checks, then admit one fresh official run on the frozen Cobrapy reference window. The official listing returns PR #1497 for 2026-10-12. This deliberately known reference tests integration; it is not an unbiased yield sample. Preserve raw versus prepared exports, original controls and timeouts, verified eligible HF evidence, and owned cleanup. No task/package/parser repairs, extra model calls or automatic dataset release.

**Bounds:** [proposed protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/b0ec61f0/experiments/45-generation-handoff/proposed-protocol.md). The proposal reserves at most 12.666667 additional reserved CPUh and $13.07 for serial built-in upstream calls, including the possible final-request overshoot beyond the $5 stop. Neither is admitted yet. All work remains inside #33’s cumulative 32 CPUh and $90 operating ceiling, including its existing $10 storage reservation, strictly below the user’s $100 extra limit. No new capacity. Keep this issue and the epic open for review; detailed evidence is in comments.

comments.body:
🤖 Source/interface preflight completed without new model calls or remote jobs.

- The pinned upstream [`prepare_dataset_for_push`](https://github.com/huggingface/Repo2RLEnv/blob/27d04ee8203cd5b2f20c3997d13836e5f5b64238/src/repo2rlenv/registry/integration.py#L406) is the existing local export stage. Calling full `push` would first create an HF dataset repository, so the handoff will invoke this same local API with inline mode instead. Upstream source stays unchanged.
- The [full-API synthetic probe](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/938cc1ea/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-export-probe.json) passes three cases: custom cache layout fails with missing recipe; expected workspace layout prepares exactly the Dockerfile/reproducibility metadata while preserving grading assets/settings; zero exports remain zero tasks. Network, subprocess and credential access were forbidden during the probe. All fixtures were removed; measured 0.10 seconds and 26,436 KiB peak RSS. This does not establish a new biological task or native control result.
- The unchanged official listing returns exactly Cobrapy PR #1497 in the inclusive 2026-10-12 window. The [finite reference protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/b0ec61f0/experiments/45-generation-handoff/proposed-protocol.md) is deliberately a known positive reference for integration, not a yield sample. A fresh bootstrap may still fail; that outcome will stay explicit.
- The [public pricing preflight](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/938cc1ea/experiments/45-generation-handoff/cost-preflight.json) gives a conservative $8.07 maximum request reservation and proposed $13.07 serial run reservation. This uses the approved Sonnet 4.6 settings, no additional repair calls, and provider actual-charge reconciliation. No reservation or paid run has been admitted. Existing epic spending/storage/CPU bounds remain in force.

Next is the checkpointed generic generation/export/validation controller, including interruption, zero-export, accounting and cleanup checks. The minimal setup adaptation is a fresh native working directory with `bootstrap.cache_dir=./workspace/bootstrap`, because the official exporter searches that layout. No installer, test, parser or grading changes are proposed. Small source/probe evidence is committed on the permanent research branch; future native evidence must receive verified eligible HF preservation before remote cleanup.

🤖 The generic **local** handoff is now implemented and verified on existing source-bound task exports; fresh generation remains pending.

- [11 offline checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a32b2964/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-checks/handoff-004/output.txt) cover real pinned exporter use, four local interruption boundaries, ambiguous caches, changed modes/policy, zero exports and injected grading-file/timeout drift. Only the local SDK fingerprint transport is mocked in the planner check; there are no model, Docker or remote execution calls.
- [Historical comparison](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/092f9054/experiments/45-generation-handoff/historical-handoff-proof.json): anonymously reacquired the exact original raw/cache members, prepared all 12 historical Cobrapy exports with the unchanged official API, and passed the mechanically generated manifest to the real supported CLI planner with no unsupported inputs. All 120 modes, grading assets, tracked test IDs and semantic settings match originals. Exactly 24 expected Dockerfile/task.toml files change. A completed local re-invocation succeeds with exporter execution forbidden; completed plan verification succeeds with SDK transport forbidden.
- These are **12 historical exports prepared and planned**, not 12 new tasks, fresh bootstrap results, new control attempts or evidence of broader yield. The initial independent check needed normalization of the validator’s archive path prefix; the failed audit and correction are retained. No task or upstream code was repaired.
- The [metadata manifest](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7b72b810/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-handoff-evidence-manifest.json) and [HF receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7b72b810/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-handoff-hf-receipt.json) bind 81 reviewed metadata members / 39,358 gzip bytes, two append-only objects and fresh anonymous readback. Raw/prepared task bytes and bootstrap/model traces are excluded. [Cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7b72b810/experiments/45-generation-handoff/local-handoff-cleanup.json) removed 1,036,918 bytes of owned fixtures/duplicate staging; canonical evidence and small exact review/resumption inputs remain under durable HOME. Nothing depends on /tmp.

New model calls, native jobs and execution reservations remain zero. Next is the trusted fresh-generation controller and conservative paid admission/recovery, reusing the validated local handoff and existing validator rather than adding task repairs. The original known-reference protocol and epic budget remain in force; this issue and the epic stay open.
